fee_proposition: Upfront EntrePass application submission fee on initial application via Visa, Mastercard, or Amex (MOM /renew-a-pass lists issuance and MJV fees without a separate SGD 105 renewal submission fee)
page_title: Apply for an EntrePass - Ministry of Manpower
supporting_excerpt: When you apply: $105 for each pass (Visa, Mastercard, or Amex). Note: if you submit your family's passes together with your EntrePass and your application is rejected, you lose the application fees for their passes as well.
refundability: Simultaneous family-pass application fees forfeited if main EntrePass application rejected; principal SGD 105 refund clause not separately stated on MOM EntrePass pages.

fee_proposition: Mandatory EntrePass pass issuance fee paid upon approval for initial issuance and renewals via GIRO, Visa, Mastercard, Amex (or NETS/CashCard at EPSC for non-Singpass); unneeded card replacement SGD 65.40 incl. GST
page_title: Renew an EntrePass - Ministry of Manpower / Apply for an EntrePass
supporting_excerpt: When you get the pass issued: $225 for each pass (Apply page updated 7 Jul 2026). Renewal cost: $225 to get the pass issued (Renew page updated 1 Jan 2026). Unneeded card return/replacement: $65.40 (including GST).
refundability: Payable only when getting the pass issued after approval; separate from upfront SGD 105 application fee and external medical/translation costs.

fee_proposition: Conditional Multiple Journey Visa (MJV) fee payable at initial issuance or renewal ONLY if the applicant's nationality/travel document requires a Singapore entry visa per ICA Visa Guidelines; SGD 0 for visa-free passports
duration_band: Matches underlying pass issuance/renewal period (conditional on ICA visa requirement)
publishing_authority: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA Singapore) & MOM Singapore
page_title: ICA Visa Requirements / MOM Apply & Renew an EntrePass
supporting_excerpt: $30 for each Multiple Journey Visa (if applicable) — paid when getting the pass issued or renewed only for travel documents requiring a Singapore entry visa under ICA guidelines (SGD 0 MJV if passport does not require a Singapore entry visa; never added into universal total).
refundability: Conditional nationality-specific charge: SGD 0 for visa-free travel documents; payable only if ICA visa requirement applies.
